Job Description
We are seeking a caring, responsible, attentive, and dependable School Bus Nanny to join its school transport team.
The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the safety, comfort, and proper supervision of pupils throughout their school bus journey, from boarding to drop off. Key Responsibilities
Supervise pupils throughout the journey to and from school, ensuring their safety and wellbeing.
Assist pupils safely when boarding and alighting from the school bus.

Provide appropriate assistance to pupils who may feel unwell or distressed during a journey and promptly notify the relevant school personnel.
Maintain confidentiality regarding pupils, parents, staff, and school matters.
Comply fully with the school’s child safeguarding, health and safety, and transport policies.

Previous experience working with children, preferably in a school, daycare, nursery, or similar environment.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to remain calm and responsible in challenging situations.

Professionalism

Job Summary
The Operations Control Room Superintendent is responsible for supervising and coordinating real-time terminal operations from the Operations Control Room to ensure safe, efficient, and hitch-free vessel and yard activities.

Operations Monitoring & Control:
Monitor live vessel and yard operations via TOS and Control Room systems
Monitor movements of Cargo Handling Equipment (CHE) across yard, shipside, and terminal through CCTV Ensure efficient use and application of TOS in monitoring and controlling operations
Ensure smooth and uninterrupted operational flow during vessel and yard activities
Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate promptly
Maintain accurate operational logs and Control Room records.
Information Dissemination & Coordination:
Disseminate relevant and accurate operational information/data to Yard and Ship-side teams in real time
Ensure efficient execution of instructions provided by the Planning team
Update vessel operation sequences based on planning instructions
Ensure effective coordination with Yard and Ship-side teams for hitch-free operations.

Monitor live vessel operations and provide real-time updates
Communicate with Shipping Agents regarding vessel operational status to support planning of berthing and sailing
Plan and coordinate vessel and terminal operations for optimal performance
Send soft copies of vessel departure reports at completion of operations to Vessel Command, Shipping Lines, Vessel Planners/Agents, and internal TICT recipients
Prepare shift reports summarizing vessel productivity, yard performance, delays, and key operational events.
Performance Monitoring & Problem Resolution
Report major operational delays or disruptions and propose corrective solutions
Analyse causes of delays associated with vessel and yard operations
Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and turnaround time
Monitor vessel productivity, yard performance, and equipment allocation through TOS dashboards
Liaise with Equipment Control team for proper distribution of equipment
Coordinate with Technical Department and Plant unit for equipment availability and fault resolution
Other Duties:
Perform any other operations-related duties as may be required to support terminal efficiency and productivity
Minimum Educational Qualifications / Certifications / Years of Experience
HND / Bachelor's Degree in Maritime Studies, Logistics, Transport Management, Engineering, or related field.

Knowledge of cargo handling equipment deployment and coordination
Strong knowledge of port/terminal operations (yard and shipside)

Ability to interpret operational dashboards and productivity metrics

Excellent communication and real-time decision-making skills
High level of situational awareness and attention to detail

Company Details:
May & Baker, Nigeria Plc was founded on September 4, 1944 as Nigeria’s first pharmaceutical company. It has its origin in England, the United Kingdom where in 1834, three chemists founded Grimwade, May & Pickett, a firm for manufacturing chemicals for pharmaceutical products. In 1839...read moreGrimwade, May & Pickett transformed into May & Baker United Kingdom Limited following some changes in the ownership. May & Baker UK Limited transformed into a mega European conglomerate through a web of mergers and acquisitions over years. Consequently the name of the company has changed at different times and today, only the Nigerian offshoot is known by the original name. 

In Nigeria the company started as May & Baker (West Africa) Limited at 17A Tinubu Street, Lagos in 1944, a trading outpost to serve the West Coast of Africa. The company relocated to its present site at Ikeja, Lagos state during the Nigerian civil war. In 1976, it built its factory at Ikeja where it began local manufacturing of pharmaceuticals. That same year it changed from May & Baker (West Africa) Limited to May & Baker Nigeria Limited

In 1979, following the indigenisation decree which required that foreign interests in companies operating in Nigeria be of a minority nature, May & Baker, United Kingdom relinquished 60 per cent of its equity holding in May & Baker Nigeria to Nigerians while retaining 40 per cent. The company’s name was changed to Embechem Nigeria Limited but this was dropped later and the name reverted to May & Baker Nigeria Limited.

May & Baker Nigeria Limited became a publicly quoted company following its listing by introduction on the Nigerian Stock Exchange on November 10, 1994 and became May & Baker Nigeria Plc.

For many years expatriates sent by the parent company managed May & Baker Nigeria but in 1997, the first indigenous Managing Director/Chief Executive Officer, Joseph Ikemefuna Odumodu, was appointed.

In 2002 the foreign partners decided to divest. However, represented by Aventis SA, France, they remained technical associates of May & Baker Nigeria Plc. Following the merger of Aventis and Sanofi, another French firm to form Sanofi Aventis in 2004, the technical relationship transferred between May & Baker Nigeria Plc and Sanofi-Aventis of France. But that relationship was renegotiated in 2005 to give May & Baker Nigeria, the leeway to have its own products.

The company thereby began an aggressive expansion and diversification programme since 2005 which has culminated in the creation of new businesses and subsidiaries. In 2005, Biovaccines, a local vaccine production subsidiary was set up in partnership with the Federal Government of Nigeria. In 2006, the company constructed a multi-billion naira food processing factory, constructed a local plant for the production of anti-retroviral drugs in Nigeria while the construction of a World Health Organization Standard Pharmaceutical production facility was constructed and commissioned on June 27, 2011

Job Description:

Plan and execute pipeline pigging operations for onshore and offshore pipelines.

pipeline integrity activities

Investigate abnormal pigging conditions and recommend corrective actions.
Coordinate safe handling and disposal of recovered debris, liquids, and contaminated materials.
Maintain accurate pigging records, run reports, pressure profiles, and operational data.

Ensure compliance with
Permit to Work (PTW), JSA/JHA, LOTO, confined-space, pressure-control, and pipeline safety requirements
.

HND or Bachelor's degree in
Mechanical, Petroleum, Pipeline, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline

Significant experience in
pipeline operations, pigging, pipeline maintenance, integrity management, or oil & gas pipeline services
.
Practical knowledge of pigging systems, pig types, launcher/receiver operations, and pipeline configurations.
Experience with
pig tracking, cleaning, gauging, batching, dewatering, and intelligent pigging
is advantageous.
Ability to interpret
P&IDs, pipeline alignment sheets, isometrics, operating procedures, and pigging drawings

Knowledge of pipeline integrity, corrosion, flow assurance, and operational constraints is an advantage.
Good understanding of pipeline pressure hazards, hydrocarbon hazards, and safe pigging practices.

Job Description:
Description
The Laboratory Manager will lead laboratory operations at the aquaculture facility, providing reliable water-quality, microbiology and pathology testing to support fish health, hatchery performance, research and biosecurity.
The role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely laboratory results, effective quality controls, safe laboratory practices, well-maintained equipment, proper sample management and actionable reporting to the Centre Lead.
Responsibilities
Laboratory Operations & Management:
Plan, organise and supervise daily laboratory activities in line with operational priorities.
Establish testing schedules, sample flows and turnaround-time standards.
Maintain laboratory readiness, cleanliness, safety and effective use of laboratory space.
Develop, implement and maintain SOPs for sampling, testing, reporting and equipment use.
Prepare routine laboratory performance reports for the Centre Lead.
Water-Quality Monitoring:
Develop and implement water-quality sampling and monitoring programmes for broodstock, hatchery and research systems.
Coordinate testing and interpretation of relevant physical and chemical water-quality parameters.
Monitor results for adverse trends and promptly communicate potential risks to relevant operational teams.
Recommend corrective actions and follow up to verify their effectiveness.
Maintain complete and traceable records of sampling locations, methods, results and follow-up actions.
Microbiology:
Manage microbiological sampling and testing of water, fish, equipment and facility environments, as applicable.
Ensure proper aseptic sampling, culture preparation, incubation, organism screening and safe disposal practices.
Monitor microbial trends and escalate results that may indicate contamination or disease risks.
Maintain traceable records of samples, media, reagents, controls and test results.
Collaborate with veterinary and production teams during microbiological investigations.
Pathology & Diagnostic Support:
Support pathology investigations through appropriate sample collection, preservation, microscopy and laboratory examination.
Coordinate diagnostic testing for suspected disease, unexplained mortality and production underperformance.
Ensure proper sample identification, chain of custody, storage and submission to external laboratories where required.
Document laboratory findings clearly and provide timely results to the Veterinarian and Centre Lead.
Maintain organised and traceable pathology specimens, images and reports.
Biosecurity:
Translate facility biosecurity requirements into practical laboratory and sampling controls.
Implement appropriate access, hygiene, disinfection, sample-handling and waste-management procedures.
Prevent cross-contamination between samples, work areas, equipment and production units.
Monitor compliance with laboratory biosecurity protocols and address identified gaps.
Support biosecurity audits, outbreak investigations and corrective-action programmes.
Quality Assurance & Data Integrity:
Implement internal quality-control checks to ensure the reliability of laboratory results.
Maintain controlled test methods, worksheets, logs, registers and electronic records.
Investigate unusual, inconsistent or out-of-specification results before release.
Ensure laboratory data are accurate, complete, traceable and securely maintained.
Coordinate proficiency testing or external verification where appropriate.
Equipment, Reagents & Inventory:
Maintain an accurate inventory of laboratory equipment, consumables, media, reagents and reference materials.
Ensure equipment is serviced, calibrated and verified according to approved schedules.
Manage reagent preparation, labelling, storage, expiry monitoring and safe disposal.
Identify and communicate requirements for equipment repair, replacement and replenishment in a timely manner.
Maintain equipment history, calibration and maintenance records.
Team Leadership, Safety & Collaboration:
Supervise, coach and develop laboratory technicians and assistants.
Train relevant employees on sampling, sample submission, hygiene and basic laboratory requirements.
Enforce laboratory safety, chemical handling, PPE and incident-reporting procedures.
Collaborate closely with the Centre Lead, Veterinarian, broodstock, hatchery and research teams.
Drive continuous improvement in testing methods, turnaround time, reporting and laboratory efficiency.
Requirements
Qualifications & Experience:
Bachelor's Degree in Microbiology, Fisheries, Aquaculture, Biological Sciences, Laboratory Science, Biochemistry or a related discipline.
Postgraduate qualification in Aquatic Animal Health, Microbiology, Pathology, Water Quality or a related field is an advantage.
Minimum of 6 years' experience managing or supervising a laboratory within aquaculture, animal health, food, environmental or biological testing.
Practical experience in water-quality analysis, microbiology, microscopy, sample management and laboratory quality control.
Experience supporting fish-health diagnostics, pathology or hatchery operations is strongly preferred.

Cross-Functional Partnership:
Act as the translation layer between our software engineering team and business stakeholders. When engineering ships a new feature, you will be right there to map the new tables and expose the data in Metabase.
Data Governance:

dialects.

Deep experience building dashboards, writing native SQL within Metabase, configuring variables, and managing Metabase environments.

Job Description:
About the job
The R&D Supervisor – Instrumentation & Sensory Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day management of the R&D laboratory's analytical instrumentation and the sensory evaluation programme.
The role ensures that all analytical equipment used in product development, quality assessment and shelf-life studies is accurately calibrated, validated and maintained, and that sensory testing (panel recruitment, training, testing and data analysis) is conducted rigorously and objectively to support new product development (NPD), product improvement, cost-optimisation and benchmarking initiatives.
The supervisor will work closely with Product Development, Quality Assurance, Production and Marketing to translate consumer and technical insights into actionable R&D decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Instrumentation Management & Analytical Testing:
Operate, calibrate and maintain R&D laboratory instruments — including texture analyzers, viscometers/rheometers, colorimeters/spectrophotometers, moisture analyzers, particle size analyzers, pH meters, water activity meters and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers, High Performance Liquid Chromatograhy (HPLC) — to ensure accuracy and reliability of results.
Develop, validate and document standard operating procedures (SOPs) and test methods for physical, physicochemical and instrumental analysis of raw materials, and finished products.
Plan and manage the instrument calibration and preventive maintenance schedule, liaising with external calibration/service providers and maintaining calibration certificates and equipment logbooks.
Troubleshoot instrument malfunctions, coordinate repairs, and escalate recurring issues to minimise laboratory downtime.
Ensure all analytical data generated is accurate, properly recorded, statistically sound and traceable, in line with GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) and ISO/food safety standards.
Drive 5S implementation and compliance in R&D instrumentation laboratory and pilot plant
Sensory Analysis & Panel Management:
Design, plan and execute sensory evaluation programmes, including difference tests (triangle, duo-trio, paired comparison), descriptive analysis (QDA), hedonic/consumer acceptance tests and shelf-life sensory monitoring.
Recruit, train, calibrate and manage the internal sensory panel; monitor panelist performance and conduct periodic re-screening to maintain panel reliability.
Coordinate consumer sensory studies and competitor/benchmarking evaluations in collaboration with Marketing and Consumer Insights teams.
Analyse sensory data using appropriate statistical tools/software, interpret results, and prepare clear, actionable reports for Product Development.
Maintain and continuously improve sensory testing protocols, panel booth standards, and sample preparation/serving procedures to ensure test validity.
Product Development Functions:
Carry out product profiling, theoretical and real time recipe development with product prototyping and other R&D bench work activities.
Develop strategic and creative new products that meets up with relevant standards of local and international food regulatory bodies.
Provide technical expertise for products in development, new or improvement of existing, planning, execution, and evaluation of projects while maintaining food safety and regulatory requirements.
Conduct and monitor product real time and accelerated shelf-life stability studies of new and optimized existing food products.
Carry out manufacturing plant trials in a pilot scale for new product development and existing product optimization.
Trouble shoot and provide solutions related to BOM, plant trials, process, and ingredient changes to prevent plant shut down across all manufacturing plants.
Supervisory & Team Leadership:
Supervise, coach and develop laboratory technicians and sensory panellists, allocating daily tasks and monitoring workload to meet project timelines.
Conduct performance reviews, identify training needs, and build technical capability within the instrumentation and sensory team.
Enforce laboratory health, safety and environmental (HSE) standards, good housekeeping (5S) and safe handling of samples, chemicals and equipment.
Act as a key point of escalation for technical queries relating to instrumentation and sensory testing within the R&D department.
Quality, Compliance & Documentation:
Ensure all testing activities comply with company quality standards, food safety regulations (e.g., NAFDAC, SON) and relevant international standards (ISO 17025, ISO 9001, HACCP).
Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation — test records, certificates of analysis (COAs), panel data, calibration records and deviation reports.
Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections by ensuring instrumentation and sensory records are complete and readily available.
Participate in root-cause investigations for product quality complaints or non-conformances requiring instrumental or sensory input.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting:
Provide instrumental and sensory data to support new product development, reformulation, cost-optimisation and shelf-life extension projects.
Collaborate with Product Development, Quality Assurance, Production, Procurement and Marketing to align testing priorities with business objectives.
Prepare and present periodic reports (weekly/monthly) on laboratory performance, sensory panel activity, and key findings to the R&D Manager.
Keep abreast of developments in analytical instrumentation and sensory science methodologies, recommending upgrades or new techniques where relevant.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's degree (BSc/HND) in Food Science & Technology, Chemistry, Biochemistry or a related scientific discipline. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
Professional certification in sensory science, laboratory quality management (e.g., ISO/IEC 17025) or instrumentation is an added advantage.
Experience:
Minimum of 3–5 years' relevant experience in a food/beverage or FMCG manufacturing laboratory, with hands-on exposure to analytical instrumentation and sensory evaluation.
Prior experience supervising or coordinating a small technical team, or demonstrable readiness for a first supervisory role.
Practical experience with sensory panel management and recognised sensory test methodologies (QDA, triangle/duo-trio tests, hedonic scaling).
Working knowledge of food safety and quality systems (GMP, HACCP, ISO standards) within a regulated manufacturing environment.

Company Details:
Promasidor was founded in 1979 by Robert Rose, who left the United Kingdom in 1957 for Zimbabwe to pursue his African dream. As Chairman of Allied Lyons Africa for over 20 years, he travelled extensively across Africa and gained a unique and thorough knowledge of the food industry throughout the con...read moretinent. In particular he noticed a lack of availability of the one highly nutritious product that the developed world takes for granted - milk.

He realised that with technology in the manufacture of milk powders advancing rapidly, there was an exciting opportunity to provide milk powder in small portions that could be packaged in flexible sachets. It was found that removing the animal fat from the milk and replacing it with vegetable fat allowed for a longer shelf life. This meant that for the first time, milk powder could be distributed across the vast African continent, providing access to affordable milk to everyone in Africa.

A passionate belief in this vision fuelled the pioneering concept of selling filled milk powder in small sachets and Promasidor began selling the Cowbell brand in the Democratic Republic of Congo (then Zaire) in 1979. Today Cowbell is sold in the majority of countries across the African continent.

We are seeking hardworking and reliable Kitchen Staff to support the smooth and efficient operation of the hotel kitchen.

Support the kitchen team in efficient day-to-day operations.

Basic food preparation and kitchen operations.
Food handling, hygiene, and sanitation.
Kitchen cleaning and organisation.
Proper use and care of kitchen equipment.
Ingredient preparation and storage.
Stock handling and waste management.
Ability to follow recipes and instructions.
Teamwork and communication.
Time management and ability to work under pressure.

Job Description:
Job Summary
As our client property portfolio continues to grow across Lekki, Ikoyi, Banana Island, and other prime locations in Lagos, we're looking for an experienced Sales & Marketing Officer who knows how to build relationships, earn client trust, and confidently close deals.
If you're passionate about real estate, understand the Lagos property market, and enjoy turning conversations into transactions, we'd love to meet you.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
You'll be the face of our properties and one of the key drivers of revenue growth.
On a typical week, you'll:
Engage prospective buyers, tenants, and investors.
Conduct property inspections and presentations.
Follow up on leads and nurture client relationships.
Negotiate and close sales and lease transactions.
Promote available properties through your network and digital channels.
Work closely with management to identify new opportunities and increase market visibility.
Guide clients through the transaction process with professionalism and confidence.
Most importantly, you'll help turn interest into signed agreements.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone with:
3–5 years of proven experience in real estate sales and marketing.
A track record of successfully closing property transactions.
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Deep understanding of Lagos real estate and property transactions.
Working knowledge of key real estate documents such as:
KYC Documentation
Deeds of Assignment
Governor's Consent
Offer Letters
Certificates of Occupancy (C of O)
Survey Plans and other title documents
You should be able to confidently discuss property details and documentation with clients without relying on constant supervision.
The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here:
Beyond experience, we're looking for character:
You'll fit in well if you:
Take ownership and follow through on commitments.
Are proactive and don't wait to be told what to do.
Enjoy building relationships and creating opportunities.
Are professional, well-presented, and confident when meeting clients.
Have a strong work ethic and genuinely enjoy closing deals.
Understand that exceptional client service often creates the biggest opportunities.
We value people who go the extra mile for clients and take pride in representing the company professionally.
Why Join Our Client?
Competitive net salary of N300,000 / month.
Attractive commission structure of 10%–20% on successful transactions.
Bonuses and seasonal welfare packages.
Access to premium property listings and quality leads.
Hybrid work arrangement designed to support productivity and work-life balance.
Opportunity to grow with a company that is actively expanding its market presence.

Job Description:
Job Purpose
The Front Desk Executive is responsible for delivering exceptional customer service by managing customer enquiries, receiving and processing service orders, operating the laundry management system, coordinating order fulfilment and ensuring a seamless customer experience from order acceptance to final collection or delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Service:
Serve as the first point of contact for customers and visitors.
Receive, attend to and resolve customer enquiries in a professional manner.
Build and maintain positive customer relationships to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
Order Management:
Receive, inspect and register customer items.
Generate customer job cards, invoices and receipts using the laundry management software.
Accurately tag and track customer garments throughout the service process.
Coordinate customer collections and delivery schedules.
Laundry Software Administration:
Operate the laundry management software for order processing, tracking and billing.
Maintain accurate customer records and transaction history.
Monitor job status and update customers on service progress where required.
Ensure data accuracy and proper documentation within the system.
Customer Experience:
Handle customer complaints and escalate operational issues where necessary.
Follow up on pending orders and ensure timely customer communication.
Promote the Company's products, services and customer loyalty programmes.
Administrative Support:
Maintain an organized front office and reception area.
Prepare daily transaction summaries and customer service reports.
Support stock monitoring of customer consumables and packaging materials.
Perform other administrative duties assigned by Management.
Additional Information:
Functional Relationships:
Production & Fulfilment Supervisor, Customer Experience Team, Business Development Team and Logistics Personnel.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Customer Satisfaction Rating
Order Entry Accuracy
Customer Complaint Resolution
Billing Accuracy
Turnaround Time for Order Processing
Customer Retention
Front Desk Efficiency
Accuracy of Laundry Software Records
Qualifications & Experience
National Diploma (ND), Higher National Diploma (HND) or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management or a related discipline.
Must have 3–5 years' experience in a professional laundry, dry-cleaning or garment care organisation.
Hands-on experience using laundry management software is mandatory.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
Core Competencies:
Customer Service Excellence
Laundry Management Software
Cash Handling & Billing
Communication & Interpersonal Skills
Attention to Detail
Problem Solving
Time Management
Professional Appearance
Sales & Customer Relationship Management
Record Keeping

The Front Desk Executive is authorized to receive customer orders, register and process transactions, issue invoices and receipts, coordinate customer collections and deliveries, update records in the laundry management system, and resolve routine customer service issues within approved procedures.

Job Description:
Job Summary
The Business Development Manager drives the Company's business acquisition, market expansion, and revenue growth across the oil & gas, EPC, construction, and related sectors.
This role will lead the identification, development, and conversion of viable business opportunities, and coordinate the business development and tendering cycle from opportunity identification through contract award.
The position will also support business development activities across the Group and develop strategic relationships with operators, EPC contractors, government agencies, consultants and other potential clients.
Responsibilities
Business Development & Opportunity Generation:
Identify, scout and develop viable business opportunities within the oil & gas, EPC, construction and related industries.
Proactively monitor the market for upcoming projects, contracts, tenders, shutdowns, maintenance opportunities, and strategic partnerships.
Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective projects and clients.
Convert identified opportunities into commercially viable business prospects.
Conduct market intelligence and competitor analysis to identify emerging opportunities and market trends.
Tendering, Bidding & Prequalification:
Lead the end-to-end tendering process, including opportunity assessment, EOI, prequalification, ITT/RFQ review, bid preparation, submission and post-tender follow-up.
Coordinate the preparation of technical, commercial and administrative tender submissions with relevant departments.
Review tender requirements, identify compliance gaps and ensure submissions meet client specifications and deadlines.
Coordinate responses to client clarifications, negotiations and commercial queries.
Maintain an organised database of tender opportunities, submissions, outcomes and lessons learned.
Client & Stakeholder Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with major oil & gas operators, EPC companies, government agencies, consultants and other strategic clients.
Identify key decision-makers and develop appropriate client engagement strategies.
Represent the Company at client meetings, industry engagements, business forums and prequalification activities.
Maintain regular follow-up with prospective clients from initial engagement through award and mobilisation.
Commercial Strategy & Business Growth:
Develop business development strategies aligned with the Company's growth objectives.
Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, joint ventures, subcontracting and consortium arrangements.
Provide management with intelligence on market conditions, competitors, pricing trends and emerging business opportunities.
Prepare business development reports, opportunity forecasts and pipeline updates for management review.
Internal Coordination & Business Conversion:
Work closely with Engineering, Projects, Finance, Procurement, HSE and other relevant departments to develop competitive bids.
Coordinate bid kick-off meetings and ensure timely submission of required inputs.
Support commercial negotiations and contract award processes.
Conduct post-bid reviews and analyse successful and unsuccessful submissions to improve future performance.
Performance Indicators
Value and number of qualified opportunities generated.
Tender success/conversion rate.
Value of contracts won.
Growth of the business development pipeline.
Number and quality of new client relationships established.
Prequalification and tender submission success rate.
Timeliness and quality of bid submissions.
Revenue generated from newly acquired business.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Economics, Management or a related discipline.
Professional qualification in Business Development, Marketing, Project Management or a related field is an advantage.
Minimum of 7 years' relevant experience, preferably within oil & gas, EPC, construction or engineering services.
Demonstrable experience in oil & gas tendering, business development and contract acquisition.
Proven track record of identifying and pursuing viable business opportunities.
Experience dealing with major operators, EPC contractors and relevant government agencies is highly desirable.
Required Competence:
Oil & gas/EPC business development expertise.
Tender and bid management.
Commercial awareness and negotiation.
Market intelligence and opportunity scouting.
Client relationship management.
Strategic thinking and business development planning.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Strong networking and stakeholder management.
Analytical and commercial decision-making ability.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant tender/business development tools.

Job Description:
Job Summary
The quality assurance officer is responsible for identifying quality problems in repaired terminals.
They will closely work with the technicians and inventory team to test repaired terminals, and identify and document defects of terminals that do not comply with standards.
They are majorly responsible for preventing defective terminals from reaching Business that could result in costly returns.
Job Description
Quality Inspection: Conducting a thorough inspection of repaired terminals to identify any defects or deviations from the standard.
Compliance: Ensuring that repaired terminals comply with the specified standards, guidelines, and technical requirements before distribution.
Visual Inspection: Careful inspection of the quality of repaired terminals through visual examination.
Testing Procedures: Implementing testing procedures using test sheets to validate the functionality and performance of repaired terminals.
Documentation: Maintaining detailed records of quality inspections, test results, and issues identified during the test process.
Collaboration: Working closely with repair technicians, engineers and relevant teams to address and rectify quality issues.
Workflow process: Developing and implementing workflow of terminal collection and returning of non-conforming terminals to inventory.
Stock keeping: Keeping proper and accurate records of received and returned terminals.
Process Improvement: Identifying areas for improvement to enhance overall repair quality and efficiency.
Perform other duties as delegated and assigned by his/her Line Manager.
Requirements
OND / HND, Bachelor's Degree in Electrical / Electronics, or a related field is preferred.
Experience in terminal repair is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reconcile discrepancies and identify areas for improvement.
Proficiency in using Microsoft Office applications.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
Strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Effective written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.
What we can offer you
Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

Job Description:
About this role
As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products.
You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due.
As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan.
You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities.
Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors.
Responsibilities
Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint
Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit
Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available
Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration
Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing
Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance
Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor
Experience & Background
Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline
Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution
Demonstrable knowledge of credit risk analysis
Good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage
Must be resident in Abia - Ohafia, Osisioma, Abia North, and Abia Central.
Skills & Competencies:
Apt attention to details
Proven simple/complex analytical skills
Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
Agility and perseverance.
What success looks like in this role:
Consistent achievement of gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets.
Maintaining a healthy, performing loan portfolio with minimized default rates through rigorous physical visitations and monitoring.
Successful onboarding and engagement of viable businesses that actively utilize Moniepoint business accounts.
Accurate credit risk assessments based on key factors like capacity, character, and capital.

Evidence of Community Service both local and National Development, and

Job Description:
About the Role
A successful payment is only part of the story. Merchants also need to receive their money, issue refunds, resolve disputes and understand where funds are at every step.
The Financial Systems team builds the products and platforms behind those experiences across Paystack’s markets.
We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape and improve this work. Your scope may include settlements, merchant payouts, refunds, disputes, treasury flows and ledger products. Priorities will change as the business and our merchants’ needs change, so you’ll need to get to grips with complex systems and make thoughtful decisions about where to focus.
You’ll own work from discovery through launch and iteration, partnering closely with engineering, data, design, Finance, Treasury, Support, Compliance and other product teams.
You’ll speak directly with merchants and internal users, use evidence to understand problems, and make sure the products we ship work well when real-world money movement gets messy.We’ll trust you to
We'll trust you to
Discover problems through merchant and internal user conversations, product data, operational incidents and partner feedback.
Map money movement flows end to end, identify dependencies and failure points, and turn complex findings into clear product decisions.
Shape and specify improvements across settlements, payouts, refunds, disputes and other Financial Systems products, based on the team’s priorities.
Work with engineers, designers and data partners to deliver solutions that are reliable, understandable and practical to operate.
Define success measures, monitor products after launch, and use what you learn to improve them.
Consider what happens when a bank or partner is unavailable, a transfer times out, a transaction sits in a partial state, or records do not reconcile.
Write clear product pitches, specifications, merchant guidance and internal documentation.
Manage escalations and align stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Support, Compliance and other teams.
Own your work within Paystack’s six-week product cycle, including presenting prioritisation pitches to the Product Council.
You’ll thrive in this role if you
At least three years of product management experience in a product team, with products you have taken through discovery, specification, delivery, launch and iteration.
Experience building or operating payment, money movement or financial infrastructure products within a fintech, financial services company or bank.
Sound judgement about how money moves in practice, including the effect that failed or delayed flows have on merchants and the business.
Strong systems thinking: you can break down an unclear problem, trace dependencies across teams and systems, and create a direction others can act on.
A habit of using data alongside customer and operational evidence to make decisions and measure outcomes.
Experience working closely with engineers on technical products, and enough technical fluency to discuss integrations, APIs, ledgers or reconciliation flows.
Confidence speaking with merchants and internal users, handling escalations, and working through competing priorities with stakeholders.
Clear writing skills and the discipline to document decisions and product changes well.
Bonus points if you have:
Ledger design or double-entry accounting experience
Multi-market African payments exposure: Ghana, South Africa, Kenya
SQL proficiency, enough to answer their own data questions
Experience building products or tooling for treasury and liquidity management, or reconciliation.
Benefits
Competitive compensation package and benefits
13th month bonus
TSG Equity compensation
Full medical coverage
Wellbeing stipend
Hybrid working environment
Smart, kind colleagues who are invested in your growth.

Job Description:
Position Overview
To support this rapid expansion, we're seeking highly skilled Field Service Engineers (FSE) who excel in powering and sustaining energy uptime.
In this pivotal role, you'll be instrumental in managing technical operations and swiftly resolving issues at the regional level.
As an FSE, your focus will be on maintaining robust technical systems to guarantee uninterrupted power at sites and optimal energy uptime at our hubs.
This role requires significant travel within Nigeria, as Jaza is expanding its operations.
This role involves owning and managing energy uptime, optimizing system performance, troubleshooting and repairing technical issues, and driving continuous improvement through data analysis, reporting, and collaboration.
The ideal candidate is someone with a strong technical/engineering background, capable of multitasking, taking initiative and working in a fast-paced environment.
Role And Responsibilities
Ensure energy uptime and power availability at sites by monitoring the system and quickly diagnosing and solving technical issues.
Support the setup of new hubs, ensure connectivity, and perform routine hub energy system maintenance. You will either travel to the hubs or remotely troubleshoot and resolve issues.
Overseeing the installation and configuration of solar panels, electrical wiring, and associated equipment.
Collaborate with Jaza Stars and the data team to diagnose and resolve technical challenges.
Document field activities and keep accurate Hub Equipment and product component inventory records.
Regularly prepare reports on hub health and other technical issues, to be submitted to the Regional Service Engineer.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related fields
Proven expertise in and a deep understanding of installing or ensuring uptime of energy systems. Ideally, this includes work with both diesel and solar systems.
2-3 years of technical/engineering experience within the telecommunications/energy industry or related sectors.
We are not particular about your educational background and are more concerned with how much hands-on experience you have.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement solutions to complex technical challenges. Strong commitment to safety and compliance with HSE standards.
Proficiency with data analysis tools and reporting software including MS Office suite and Google products.
Ablity to work independently and effectively in a team environment.
Passion for our mission of increasing energy access.
Open to learning and tech-savvy.
Must have skills:
Solar Design
Solar Installation
Solar Inverter Maintenance
Electrical Installation
Electrical Design.

Work very hard on solving very hard problems.
Be part of the most exciting growth phase of the company.
Work with great teammates in a global environment. Our team is spread across Canada, China, Tanzania, New York and Nigeria.

The Opportunity
The Director, Business Development & Partnerships will lead business development, market expansion, product/service commercialization, and strategic partnership development across Intersect Consortium and its portfolio of businesses.
Key Objective
The primary objective of the role is to move Intersect Consortium and its individual businesses from their current commercial position to the next stage of sustainable growth.
The Director will be expected to identify commercial opportunities that may already exist within the Consortium but are currently underdeveloped, under-marketed, under-packaged,or under-commercialized.
The role will combine:
Business Development + Product Development + Market Expansion + Partnerships + Commercial Strategy + Sales Enablement + Market Intelligence.
Scope of The Role
The Director will work across the Consortium's diverse portfolio, including:
Mental health and treatment centres
Rehabilitation services
Women's mental health services
Pharmaceutical services
Technology/IT businesses
Manufacturing businesses
Professional services
Other service-based entities within the Consortium.
The Director must therefore be comfortable working across different industries, customer segments, purchasing processes and revenue models.
Key Responsibilities
Consortium-Wide Business Development Strategy:
Develop and implement a Consortium-wide business development strategy.
Establish annual and quarterly business development targets.
Translate the Consortium's overall business strategy into measurable commercial initiatives.
Develop growth plans for individual entities and business units.
Identify priority markets, sectors, customer segments, and geographic opportunities.
Establish business development standards and processes across the Consortium.
Develop a common pipeline-management framework.
Establish reporting structures for business development performance.
Coordinate business-development activities across entities to avoid duplication and identify opportunities for cross-selling.
Regularly review the commercial performance of each business unit and recommend corrective actions.
Business Growth Diagnostics:
The Director will act as an internal growth consultant to the Consortium and its businesses.
This includes:
Assessing the current commercial position of each business.
Reviewing existing products and services.
Identifying underutilized capabilities.
Identifying services with low awareness or weak market penetration.
Assessing pricing and packaging.
Reviewing existing customer segments.
Identifying revenue leakage and missed commercial opportunities.
Assessing competitors and market positioning.
Identifying barriers to sales.
Determining whether problems relate to product, pricing, positioning, distribution, awareness, sales capability, or market access.
Developing practical growth interventions.
Product & Service Development:
A major responsibility of this role will be turning existing expertise and capabilities into sellable products and services.
The Director will:
Identify new product and service opportunities.
Develop commercially viable service packages.
Repackage existing services for new customer segments.
Create corporate and institutional service offerings.
Develop bundled service solutions across Consortium entities.
Identify opportunities for subscription, retainer, contract, or recurring-revenue models.
Develop pricing and packaging recommendations.
Work with technical, clinical, and operational teams to validate feasibility.
Develop product / service propositions and value propositions.
Test new offerings with target markets.
Develop go-to-market plans.
Establish commercial launch plans for new products and services.
Government Sector Business Development:
The Director will develop and execute strategies for accessing relevant government markets.
This includes:
Identify relevant Federal, State and Local Government opportunities.
Map ministries, departments, agencies and government institutions relevant to Consortium services.
Identify decision-makers, influencers and procurement stakeholders.
Develop government-sector value propositions.
Identify relevant tenders, programmes, contracts and partnership opportunities.
Develop institutional engagement strategies.
Build relationships with relevant government stakeholders.
Coordinate preparation for bids, proposals and presentations.
Establish a structured government-sector pipeline.
Monitor government procurement and programme opportunities.

About the Role
We are looking for someone who can sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, understand the big picture, translate it into measurable objectives, and ensure the details required to get there don't disappear along the way.

First: Strategy:
The successful candidate will help oversee Intersect's overall strategic direction, including the implementation and continuous improvement of the Consortium's Objectives and Key Results (OKR) framework.
They will work with Directors and Heads of Departments to translate organizational priorities into clear objectives and measurable Key Results, challenge vague or poorly defined targets, monitor progress, and help management understand where execution is succeeding or falling behind.

Key Responsibilities
The Head of Strategy & Operations will:
Support the development and execution of Intersect Consortium's overall strategy.
Own the coordination and governance of the Consortium's OKR framework.
Work with departments and business units to develop meaningful Key Results.
Monitor organizational performance against strategic objectives.
Identify execution gaps and recommend corrective action.
Support Directors and Heads of Departments in translating strategy into measurable action.
Establish systems that improve accountability and follow-through.
Provide structured operational support to the UK clinic.
Develop and document administrative and operational processes.

Strategy & OKR Leadership:

Support the development of the Consortium's annual and multi-year strategic plans.
Translate the organization's vision into strategic priorities.
Support management in identifying strategic opportunities and risks.
Coordinate strategic planning sessions.
Conduct research and analysis to support strategic decision-making.
Monitor internal and external developments that may affect the Consortium.
Prepare strategy papers, briefing notes and management presentations.
Track progress against strategic priorities.
Identify areas where strategy is not translating effectively into execution.
Recommend improvements to management.
OKR Framework Ownership:
The Head of Strategy & Operations will be responsible for coordinating and strengthening this process.
Responsibilities include:
Coordinate the implementation of OKRs across the Consortium.
Develop OKR guidelines and templates.
Work with Directors and Heads of Departments to develop departmental OKRs.
Facilitate OKR-setting sessions.
Challenge Key Results that are vague, activity-based, or difficult to measure.
Ensure Key Results are measurable and linked to organizational priorities.
Ensure departmental OKRs support the Consortium's overall strategic objectives.
Identify dependencies between departments.
Maintain a centralized OKR tracker/dashboard.
Establish OKR review cycles.
Monitor progress against Key Results.
Identify delayed or off-track objectives.
Work with responsible leaders to understand barriers to execution.
Escalate material risks and delays to management.
Support quarterly and annual OKR reviews.
Recommend adjustments where organizational priorities change.
Departmental Strategy Support:

Understanding each department's responsibilities.
Understanding departmental objectives.
Helping teams translate broad ambitions into measurable Key Results.
Identifying duplicated or conflicting objectives.
Identifying dependencies between teams.
Reviewing progress.
Helping teams identify barriers.
Supporting departments in developing action plans.
Providing constructive challenges where targets are unrealistic, unclear, or insufficiently ambitious.

Organizational restructuring, New business initiatives, Market-entry projects, Process improvement,
New centre development, Cross-consortium projects, etc.
Process Design & Documentation:
A major responsibility of the role is ensuring that important processes are documented, repeatable, and trackable.
Identify process gaps, identify duplicated steps, identify bottlenecks.
Develop SOPs and workflow documents, establish process owners.
Establish escalation points, review processes periodically. Ensure process changes are documented.

Preparing meeting agendas, maintaining action trackers,
Recording decisions and action points, Following up on agreed actions,
Coordinating information from multiple departments, ensuring management requests are followed through,
Maintaining a central record of important strategic decisions and commitments.

Purpose of the Position
The Software Engineering Department at eHealth Africa designs and maintains digital health solutions that strengthen healthcare systems across Africa.
We develop innovative platforms such as eHA Care, LoMIS, and PlanField and collaborate with partners to optimize tools like EMID and VaxTrac.
Our diverse team—software developers, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, and AI engineers—builds secure, scalable systems tailored to public health needs.
We prioritize real-world impact, user-centric design, and integration with health programs.
The department also contributes to local tech talent development through the eHA Academy and provides career growth opportunities within a supportive, innovative environment.
The Senior Coordinator, UI/UX Design leads the end-to-end design and development of user experiences and interfaces across eHealth Africa’s digital products.
This role is accountable for creating seamless, accessible, and compelling interactions across platforms—ensuring alignment with organizational goals and the needs of a diverse user base.
S/he will also provide leadership in applying current design paradigms, accessibility standards, and brand consistency throughout all digital assets.
What you’ll do
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned:
Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of user experience and interface design across web and mobile platforms.
Translate user needs and product objectives into wireframes, prototypes, and detailed design specifications.
Maintain and evolve a scalable design system aligned with brand guidelines, accessibility standards, and cross-platform consistency.
Integrate usability and accessibility principles into each stage of the product lifecycle, from concept through deployment.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and marketing teams to shape user journeys and define product touchpoints.
Provide UX leadership in sprint planning, design reviews, and stakeholder discussions to ensure alignment and feasibility.
Coordinate with front-end developers and quality assurance teams to implement, test, and validate UI/UX elements throughout development cycles.
Deliver responsive, high-fidelity mockups, design assets, and implementation-ready specifications using tools like Figma.
Create and maintain documentation, including style guides, design flows, and usability insights to support team continuity.
Monitor product performance post-launch and continuously iterate on design based on user feedback, behavioral data, and evolving trends.
Who you are
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required to successfully perform this job.
Strategic Designer – Demonstrated ability to think holistically and translate abstract ideas into elegant, user-centered design solutions.
Process Optimizer – Skilled in delivering high-quality, consistent designs across multiple platforms and product lines.
UX Systems Advocate – Maintains and evolves scalable design systems, adapting them to shifting technologies and organizational needs.
Cross-Functional Collaborator – Effectively bridges communication between developers, product managers, and marketers to align on shared goals.
Detail-Driven – Brings precision and intentionality to every design element, from typography to micro-interactions, creating experiences that feel as good as they look.
Data-Informed – Combines creativity with user feedback, analytics, and industry best practices to inform and refine design solutions.
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
5-6 years of professional UI/UX or Product Design experience, with demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex digital products across web and mobile platforms.
Strong portfolio demonstrating end to end product design, including user research, user flows, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, usability testing and shipped product outcomes.
Advanced proficiency in Figma or equivalent design tools, including components, Auto Layout, variables, prototyping, design libraries and developer handoff.
Strong experience creating, maintaining and contributing to scalable design systems, reusable components and consistent product experiences.
Demonstrated experience conducting user research and usability testing, synthesising findings and translating insights into actionable product improvements.
Experience using AI assisted design and research tools to support activities such as ideation, research synthesis, content exploration and rapid prototyping.
Proven experience in creating interactive designs and conducting usability testing.
Working knowledge of HTML and CSS and an understanding of frontend development constraints.
Experience using AI assisted design and research tools to support activities such as ideation, research synthesis, content exploration and rapid prototyping.
Experience designing healthcare, digital health, public sector or other complex enterprise products.
Deep understanding of interaction design, visual hierarchy, design systems, and usability testing.
Certifications and Licenses:
CPACC, IAAP, UX Design Certification or its equivalent.

SERVICE DIMENSIONS
Perimeter: Affiliate-wide responsibility across COMPANY, supporting more than 3,000 users in onshore, offshore and deep-offshore operations.
Financial Data: The affiliate’s digital ambition is to generate annual value of US$150–200 million from 2025.
Statistical Data: The affiliate deploys 7–10 new headquarters and locally developed digital products annually and supports more than 20 solutions across assets, field operations, technical services, projects, procurement, logistics, finance and other functions. Approximately 35 training sessions across 10 D&I courses reach 350 participants each year, complemented by 4–5 hybrid engagement events. The role supports more than 3,000 users across over 35 business entities, two innovation rooms in Lagos and Port Harcourt, and multiple D&I communication channels and platforms. Complexity: Embedding a sustainable D&I culture across geographically dispersed and operationally diverse teams requires tailored change, communication and capability-building interventions. The role must translate a dynamic D&I roadmap into practical adoption actions while balancing varied user expectations, business priorities and operational constraints.
ACTIVITIES
The Change Management Lead supports the implementation of the affiliate’s Digital & Innovation change, communication and capability-building activities under the direction of the Design & Innovation Leader. The role works closely with D&I workstreams and business stakeholders to prepare users for new digital products, processes and ways of working, support effective product adoption and provide the Manager with reliable insights for advising D&I Leadership. Key responsibilities include:
Change planning and coordination: Support the Design & Innovation Leader in developing and maintaining change management plans for D&I initiatives, aligned with project milestones, business priorities and implementation requirements.
Impact and readiness assessment: Conduct change impact, stakeholder and user-readiness assessments; document adoption barriers, operational risks and capability gaps; and propose practical mitigation actions for review by the Manager.
Stakeholder engagement: Coordinate engagement with project sponsors, line managers, change champions and users to communicate expected changes, gather feedback and support timely adoption across business entities.
Change communication: Prepare and implement communication plans with D&I Product Managers, Product Owners, including audience mapping, key messages, communication materials, channels and schedules, subject to the Manager’s guidance and approval.
Capability building: Coordinate role-based training, digital literacy, user guidance and reinforcement activities to help employees use digital solutions effectively within their operational environment.
Deployment support: Support business teams during mobilisation, go-live and stabilisation by tracking readiness actions, user concerns, training completion and adoption issues, and escalating significant gaps to the Manager.
Adoption monitoring and reporting: Track agreed indicators for awareness, readiness, participation, utilisation, user experience and benefits; prepare regular reports and recommendations to support the D&I Leadership’s engagement with the SLT and business entities.
Culture and innovation engagement: Plan and coordinate digital and innovation events, including D&I Week, hackathons, seminars, boot camps and roadshows, and develop success stories that promote participation and demonstrate practical business value.
Ideation workshop facilitation: Plan and facilitate structured ideation workshops with business teams and D&I stakeholders to identify operational challenges, generate potential digital initiatives, document proposed use cases and support their initial assessment and progression through the D&I opportunity pipeline.
Communities and communication channels: Administer D&I Champions Networks, communities, and communication platforms; maintain the engagement calendar; publish approved content; and ensure that user questions and feedback are captured and followed up.
Innovation facilities and partnerships: Coordinate the day-to-day use and programming of the Lagos and Port Harcourt innovation rooms and provide operational support for approved open innovation activities and partnerships.
Documentation and process support: Coordinate the drafting, review, publication and periodic update of D&I policies, procedures, user guides and reference materials within the Corporate Management System.
Quality assurance and improvement: Conduct scheduled quality checks on D&I processes and digital products, consolidate user feedback, monitor relevant SLAs and KPIs, and submit improvement recommendations to the Manager.
CONTEXT AND ENVIRONMENT
Digital and innovation are new strategic levers and an emerging culture in the affiliate. They would require drastic change of users’ attitude and mindset. Convincing and onboarding users would therefore require innovative approach and custom-made change management measures supported by appropriate capacity building program.
The Company has identified the opportunities offered by Digital & Innovation, and affiliates are encouraged to take maximum advantage of the new ways of working and the opportunities they offer by transforming their business processes. The targeted values to be generated from digital and innovation initiatives are high and would require a drastic shift in mindset and culture.

Excellent knowledge of the principles and practices of Innovation Management, Digital transformation, Agile methodology, Change Management and Communication. Must possess strong relationship management skills.

The Network Engineering Lead will spearhead the design, implementation, operational management, performance tuning, and strategy for Fieldbase's LTE infrastructure and upcoming 5G network expansion.

Network Strategy, Design & Architecture
Core Network Architecture:
Design, dimension, and implement a highly scalable, secure Evolved Packet Core (EPC) / 5G Core (5GC).
RAN Integration:
Lead RF planning, dimensioning, and deployment of Band 40 (2.3 GHz) TDD-LTE infrastructure, including macro cells, small cells, and base stations.
Hybrid Backhaul Integration:
Architect backhaul routing strategies leveraging Fieldbase's Starlink capabilities and terrestrial fiber to ensure resilient, low-latency connectivity.

Establish operational workflows, KPIs, monitoring tools, and SLAs to ensure 99.99% uptime for enterprise clients.
Optimization:
Continuously monitor and tune RF parameters, core routing, and QoS policies to optimize network performance and user experience.
Security & Troubleshooting:
Serve as the Level 3 escalation point for complex core network failures, security breaches, or performance degradation.
Private LTE Solutions:
Design secure Layer 2 and Layer 3 Private LTE solutions for enterprise customers, including:
Oil & Gas
Mining
Manufacturing

Build and lead the Network Engineering function, including Core Network, RAN, Transport, NOC, and Field Engineering teams.

Job Description:
About the MEL Officer Role
Data and evidence are central to our work. As Notify Health continues to scale our vaccination reminder programs across Nigeria, we are looking for a Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) officer who will ensure excellence in data collection, analysis, and reporting by executing high-volume monitoring and evaluation tasks with efficiency, accuracy, and attention to detail.
The MEL Officer role is centered around hands-on execution of routine data processes. You will spend a substantial share of your week reviewing data submissions from health workers and partner staff, grading them, deciding what is usable, correcting errors, and providing feedback that helps improve our data quality over time. You will conduct routine audits and data analysis to ensure a high-quality program. You will also play an important role in the evolution of our data pipeline. As the person who sees our processes more often than anyone else, you will be in the best position to identify what is inefficient or prone to error and to propose improvements. This is an ideal role for someone enthusiastic about technology, with a few years of M&E experience, who is excellent at careful, detailed data work and wants to use their skills to improve children’s health.
Role responsibilities
Executing the MEL system (60%)
Review data submissions from health workers and field staff, and provide clear feedback to improve record-keeping and photo quality.
Conduct continuous auditing of program and project implementation and produce thoughtful reports and recommendations.
Support program evaluation activities through data processing, cleaning, and analysis.
Facilitating an accurate digitization process (20%)
Review photos of health records, and determine which go to data entry and which are discarded.
Oversee digitization by data entry staff, ensuring timelines are met and troubleshooting issues where required.
Review completed data entries for quality issues and mistakes before enrolling caregivers for reminders.
Review, adjudicate, and determine the likely cause of data entry discrepancies.
Produce feedback and reports for the data entry team.
Improving processes, training, and learning (20%)
Travel to key training days, and teach SurveyCTO data collection and data entry using our forms, templates, and processes.
Contribute MEL learnings to regular program meetings in each implementation State
Propose and implement ways to make M&E processes more efficient, such as through process improvements, automations, or template improvements.
About you
You’re a careful, reliable, and detail-oriented data person who is comfortable handling a high volume of routine data tasks, maintaining high accuracy throughout. You notice when something looks off in a dataset, and you troubleshoot and communicate problems clearly and promptly. You don’t shy away from advocating process improvements to help our program and data systems run more robustly and efficiently. If you thrive in a start-up environment, care deeply about data integrity, and are motivated by using evidence to improve health outcomes for children, we would love to hear from you.
Essential
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent professional experience) in a relevant field such as Public Health, Epidemiology, Statistics, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Development Economics, Computer Science, or Business Administration
At least 3 years of hands-on experience in Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning, program analytics, or similar data-driven roles in health or development programs
Strong practical skills with spreadsheets, particularly Google Sheets, for data management, analysis, and reporting
Excellent attention to detail and ability to execute repetitive data processes with high accuracy
Clear and proactive communication skills in written and spoken English
Fluency in Nigerian Pidgin
Comfortable working remotely with a home office setup including reliable internet and a laptop or desktop.
Strong alignment with Notify Health\'s mission and a commitment to using data honestly and rigorously.
Preferred
Familiarity with digital data collection platforms such as SurveyCTO, ODK, or KoboToolbox.
Experience training others to use data tools
Additional Nigerian languages, particularly Ebira, Tiv, or Fulfulde
Experience in the Nigerian health system, ideally on programs working directly with CSOs, health workers, and facility-level data. Immunisation experience is a plus.
Proficiency with data analysis or automation tools such as SQL, Google Data Studio, or Google Apps Script
Benefits
As part of an early stage organization, you will have a large amount of autonomy in how you set up your day-to-day work. Exact hours and work location are flexible.
Financial support for facilitating an optimal remote working environment
Developmental budget for upskilling/training
Competitive annual leave
Competitive maternity leave after one year of employment
Compensation
We aim to offer fair, competitive compensation aligned with local living costs and candidate experience. While salaries vary significantly by location and experience, we expect most candidates to fall within a range of
NGN 500,000 - 730,000 (USD 370 - 550) per month.
Other details
Location:
Nigeria, remote (Abuja preferred)
Travel:
Up to 10%, mainly to our implementation sites
Contract:
12 months with possibility of renewal subject to satisfactory performance.
This role has a 6-month probationary period for you to get to know us and for us to get to know you better.
We respect your time and have designed our application process to reflect this. The first step of the application process takes 45-60 minutes, including an application form and a short 10-minute quiz, and does not require a cover letter. We only ask for more time from applicants we think would be an excellent fit. Following the application, there will be additional steps including test tasks and interviews. We endeavour to respond to each stage in the process within two weeks of the deadline; however, timing may vary depending on the number of applicants in any given cycle.
Women are strongly encouraged to apply for this position.

Strategic & Team Leadership:

Research global fashion, lifestyle, retail, and visual merchandising trends to inform styling and merchandising strategies.
Benchmark leading international fashion brands and best-in-class visual merchandising practices.
Recommend innovative styling concepts and merchandising ideas that enhance the customer experience and strengthen the brand's premium positioning.
Stay updated on emerging fashion trends, styling techniques, colour trends, and consumer preferences relevant to the brand's target market.

Technical Competencies:
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Fashion Merchandising, Fashion Design, Retail Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline with 6 – 7 years' experience in fashion styling, visual merchandising, fashion retail, or a related creative fashion environment.
Retail Fashion, Visual Merchandising, or Fashion Styling certification is an added advantage.
Strong knowledge of fashion retail environments, store layouts, display fixtures, mannequins, and premium visual merchandising standards.
Proven experience in fashion styling, campaign execution, photoshoots, look creation, and visual storytelling.
Strong ability to create complete and commercially relevant fashion looks across different product categories.
Experience working with fashion collections, product launches, lookbooks, campaigns, or retail styling is highly desirable.
Behavioural Competencies:
Highly creative with exceptional fashion sense, artistic ability, and colour intelligence.
Strong understanding of fashion trends, customer buying behaviour, and premium retail presentation.
Excellent planning, prioritisation, and time management skills.
Detail-oriented with strong visual judgement and commercial awareness.
Confident communicator with excellent training, coaching, and team leadership capability.
Energetic, collaborative, innovative, and results-driven.

Information Security Governance, Risk & Compliance
Develop, maintain and periodically review the organization's Information Security Governance and GRC framework.
Assess compliance with applicable CBN circulars, guidelines, regulatory requirements and information-security standards.
Maintain an information security and technology risk register, including risk identification, assessment, treatment, ownership and remediation tracking.
Develop and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, control frameworks and control matrices.
Conduct periodic reviews of information security controls and assess their design and operating effectiveness.
Monitor regulatory changes affecting the organization's technology, cybersecurity, payments and information-security obligations.
Prepare regulatory and management reports relating to technology risk, cybersecurity and control effectiveness.

CBN & Financial Services Regulatory Compliance
Assess technology and cybersecurity controls against applicable CBN requirements, including the Nigerian Payments System Risk and Information Security Management Framework (NPSR-ISMF) and other applicable CBN payment system regulations and guidelines.
Maintain a regulatory obligations register covering relevant CBN requirements and monitor compliance.
Evaluate the organization's readiness for CBN supervisory reviews, inspections and information requests.
Review controls supporting the security, availability, integrity and resilience of payment services.
Assess technology controls supporting electronic payment channels, transaction processing, APIs, integrations and other critical payment infrastructure.
Monitor compliance with applicable requirements relating to operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, access control, transaction security, logging and monitoring.

Data Protection & Privacy Assurance
Assess compliance of technology and business processes with the Nigeria Data Protection Act and other applicable NDPC requirements.
Review controls for the collection, processing, storage, transmission, retention and disposal of personal and financial data.
Conduct or support privacy and data protection control assessments, including reviews of data flows and third party processing arrangements.
Assess security safeguards protecting customer and employee personal data.
Review data protection risks associated with cloud services, APIs, vendors and other third parties.
Support privacy impact/risk assessments for new products, systems and technology initiatives.
Work with all teams to identify and remediate data protection control gaps.
IT & Systems Auditing

Evaluate IT General Controls (ITGCs) and application controls.
Review access management, privileged access, segregation of duties and authentication mechanisms.
Assess system development lifecycle and secure software development practices.
Review change management processes and production deployment controls.
Evaluate business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities for critical technology services.
Prepare detailed audit reports identifying control weaknesses, root causes, risk implications and corrective actions.

Conduct technical security assessments of applications, APIs, networks, servers, cloud environments and other technology assets.
Perform vulnerability assessments and review vulnerability management processes.
Analyze vulnerability scan and security testing results and assess risks based on business impact.
Review remediation of identified vulnerabilities and validate closure of critical findings.
Conduct security configuration reviews against recognized security benchmarks and industry best practices.
Review application security controls, including authentication, authorization, session management, encryption and API security.
Assess security controls around critical payment systems and customer facing digital channels.
Review penetration testing reports and independently assess the adequacy of remediation.
Identify emerging technology and cybersecurity risks and recommend appropriate mitigating controls.

Review vendor due diligence and ongoing security assurance processes.
Assess contractual security requirements, data protection obligations, service level agreements and incident notification provisions.
Review third party audit reports, certifications and security assessments.
Monitor remediation of security and control weaknesses identified in third party assessments.

Review the effectiveness of cybersecurity incident response processes.
Assess security monitoring, SIEM/logging, alerting and incident escalation controls.
Review controls for identifying, containing and recovering from cybersecurity incidents.
Participate in post incident reviews and assess root causes and remediation plans.
Evaluate technology resilience, business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements.

Prepare concise and actionable audit reports for management and relevant stakeholders.
Communicate technical vulnerabilities and cybersecurity risks.
Provide risk based recommendations that balance security, regulatory obligations, customer protection and business objectives.

Demonstrable experience conducting IT audits and control assessments.
Practical experience performing or reviewing vulnerability assessments and technical security reviews.
