Demonstrates strong conceptual and analytical thinking skills.
Demonstrates effective stakeholder and relationship management.
Demonstrates proficiency in digitisation and process improvement.
Communicates ideas clearly through effective business presentations.
Demonstrates strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Builds positive and productive interpersonal relationships.
Manages conflicts constructively and professionally.
Demonstrates effective time and self-management.
Demonstrates effective project management skills.
Bachelor's degree or its equivalent
3-5 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery facilitator for software/product teams.
Practical experience working with cross-functional teams comprising software engineers, QA engineers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, UX/UI, DevOps, and other stakeholders.
Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps/Boards, Confluence, or equivalent platforms.
Strong working knowledge of requirement documentation, Scrum, Kanban, agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation techniques, release planning, and continuous improvement.
Exposure to wealth management platforms, core banking systems, or capital markets technology.
Demonstrated ability to manage dependencies, facilitate difficult conversations, resolve delivery friction, and influence without formal authority. Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Job Description:
Job Summary
The Growth Product Manager will own adoption, usage and commercial growth across ARM’s digital platforms, turning customer insight, behavioral data and commercial priorities into scalable improvements across acquisition, onboarding, activation, funding, repeat investment, retention, referral and measurable business growth.
This is a hybrid growth-operator role rather than a purely marketing or purely product remit: it connects growth-hacking and rapid experimentation, hands-on ownership of the marketing technology (Martech) stack and lifecycle campaign orchestration, and disciplined product management into a single, measurable growth engine.
The successful candidate will identify the highest-value friction points in the customer journey, build and priorities a measurable growth roadmap, and lead cross-functional squads to test, ship and scale solutions that increase active investors and assets under management while maintaining customer trust, regulatory compliance and healthy unit economics.
Job Details
Growth Strategy and Roadmap
Define the product-led growth strategy for ARM’s digital wealth platforms, aligned with enterprise priorities, target customer segments and commercial objectives.
Translate growth goals into clear product outcomes, quarterly OKRs, initiatives and sequenced roadmaps.
Develop a robust understanding of customer needs, barriers to investing, channel behaviours, competitor propositions and market trends.
Prioritize opportunities using expected customer value, impact on assets under management, revenue potential, delivery effort, risk and strategic fit.
Balance near-term funnel improvements with longer-term investments in scalable growth loops, platform capabilities and customer lifetime value.
Funnel Optimization and Experimentation
Apply growth-hacking methods; rapid, structured experiments, referral loops, and landing-page/conversion-rate optimization to unlock quick wins alongside the core roadmap.
Own the end-to-end growth funnel and identify conversion leaks through quantitative analysis, customer research, service data and frontline feedback.
Improve registration, identity verification, risk profiling, bank-account verification, funding and first-investment journeys to reduce avoidable abandonment.
Design and run well-governed experiments, including A/B tests, pilots and cohort-based tests, with clear hypotheses, success criteria, guardrails and post-test decisions.
Optimize time-to-value so new customers quickly experience the benefit of investing through ARM.
Build repeatable growth loops such as referrals, recurring investments, goal-based investing, cross-sell, reactivation and content-to-investment journeys.
Ensure experiments do not create misleading claims, unsuitable nudges, dark patterns or unacceptable customer, operational or regulatory risk.
Customer Acquisition, Activation and Lifecycle Growth
Partner with Marketing, Sales and Partnerships to connect acquisition campaigns to seamless, measurable in-product journeys.
Improve channel quality and conversion by aligning audience, proposition, landing experience, onboarding and next best offers.
Develop lifecycle strategies for activation, education, repeat business, cross selling, engagement, maturity or redemption events, dormancy prevention and win-back.
Use segmentation and personalization responsibly to deliver relevant prompts, educational content and financial planning pathways.
Support partner and embedded distribution propositions by defining customer experience, product requirements, economics and operating model.
Martech, Campaigns and Lifecycle Orchestration
Own the Martech stack for growth — CRM, marketing automation, campaign management and messaging tool partnering with Data/IT and Marketing on configuration, integration and vendor management.
Design and orchestrate always-on and triggered lifecycle campaigns across push, email, SMS/WhatsApp and in-app messaging, sequencing content and offers to each stage of the customer journey: awareness, sign-up, KYC, first funding, first investment, repeat business, cross selling and win-back.
Build and maintain customer segmentation and behavioural triggers or live events (e.g. onboarding drop-off, low first funding, dormancy risk) that drive automated, personalized lifecycle journeys rather than one-off blasts.
Ensure accurate campaign attribution and channel-performance measurement, working with Data and Engineering to connect Martech tooling into the core analytics and event-tracking stack.
Continuously test and refine messaging, timing, channel mix, creative and offers to improve activation, engagement, repeat investment and reactivation outcomes.
Data, Insights and Performance Management
Define the growth measurement framework, including the north-star metric, leading indicators, funnel definitions and metric ownership.
Work with Data and Engineering to ensure reliable event tracking, attribution, cohorting, dashboards and experiment measurement.
Apply behavioural analytics — cohort analysis, event-level tracking, behavioural segmentation, activation-metric design, churn-signal detection and retention-curve analysis — to understand how customers actually move through the product, not just where they drop off.
Monitor performance by segment, product, platform, channel and cohort; distinguish sustainable growth from short-term volume.
Build business cases and forecasts for growth initiatives, including expected incremental funded accounts, net flows, revenue, cost and payback.
Communicate results, lessons, risks and recommended decisions clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Product Delivery and Cross-functional Leadership
Lead a cross-functional growth squad comprising Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing and Operations partners.
Turn opportunities into clear product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, analytics requirements and launch plans.
Maintain a prioritized backlog and make transparent trade-offs based on evidence, capacity, value, dependencies and risk.
Partner with Design and Research to create simple, accessible and trustworthy experiences for customers with different levels of financial literacy.
Coordinate releases, operational readiness, customer communication, support playbooks and post-launch monitoring.
Remove delivery blockers, manage dependencies and create a strong cadence for discovery, experimentation, delivery and learning.
Risk, Compliance and Customer Trust
Partner early with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Information Security, Data Privacy, Internal Control and Operations throughout discovery and delivery.
Ensure journeys and communications comply with applicable capital-market requirements, KYC, AML/CFT/CPF, data-protection, and internal governance standards.
Protect suitability, transparency and informed customer choice; ensure fees, risks, returns and product terms are presented clearly.
Define and monitor guardrail metrics covering complaints, failed transactions, fraud, reversals, operational incidents, suitability concerns and customer harm.
Maintain appropriate documentation, approvals, experiment records and audit trails
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
Typically, 5–8 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years owning digital products or growth outcomes in fintech, investments, wealth management, banking, payments, e-commerce or another high-volume digital business.
Demonstrated success improving measurable outcomes across acquisition, activation, retention, monetization or referral funnels.
Hands-on experience with product discovery, roadmapping, agile delivery, experimentation and lifecycle optimization.
Strong analytical capability, including funnel analysis, cohorts, segmentation, experiment design, unit economics and business-case development.
Experience working with product/behavioural analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude or GA4), business-intelligence and experimentation platforms, and hands-on ownership of a CRM or marketing-automation/martech platform (e.g. Braze, CleverTap, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or HubSpot) for lifecycle campaign orchestration; working knowledge of SQL is strongly preferred.
Practical experience designing and running behavioural-segmentation and lifecycle-messaging programmes (push, email, SMS/WhatsApp, in-app) across acquisition, activation, retention and win-back journeys.
Sound understanding of digital financial-services operations, customer onboarding, payments, identity verification and regulated product delivery.
Experience in Assets management will be an added advantage.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading cross-functional teams without relying solely on formal authority.

UBA’s has more than 65 years of providing uninterrupted banking operations dating back to 1948 when the British and French Bank Limited ("BFB”) commenced business in Nigeria. BFB was a subsidiary of Banque Nationale de Crédit (BNCI), Paris, which transformed its London branc...read moreh into a separate subsidiary called the British and French Bank, with shares held by Banque Nationale de Crédit and two British investment firms, S.G. Warburg and Company and Robert Benson and Company. A year later, BFB opened its offices in Nigeria to break the monopoly of the two existing British owned banks in Nigeria then.

Following Nigeria’s independence from Britain, UBA was incorporated on 23, February 1961 to take over the business of BFB. UBA eventually listed its shares on the Nigerian Stock Exchange (NSE), in 1970 and became the first Nigerian bank to subsequently undertake an Initial Public Offering (IPO). UBA became the first sub-Saharan bank to take its banking business to North America when it opened its New York Office (USA) in 1984 to offer banking services to Africans in Diaspora.

Today’s UBA emerged from the merger of then dynamic and fast growing Standard Trust Bank, incorporated in 1990 and UBA, one of the biggest and oldest banks in Nigeria. The merger was consummated on August 1, 2005, one of the biggest mergers done on the Nigerian Stock Exchange (NSE). Following the merger, UBA subsequently went ahead to acquire Continental Trust Bank in the same year, further expanding the UBA brand. UBA subsequently acquired Trade Bank in 2006 which was under liquidation by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN).

Job Description:
Compensation: ₦1,200,000 – ₦1,500,000 monthly
Reports to: Managing Director / Owner
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded General Manager to lead the growth, performance and operations of the Group’s portfolio of businesses and emerging ventures. The role sits at the intersection of real estate, investments/wealth management, mobility, logistics and new business development. The successful candidate will be responsible for translating the Group’s investment vision into commercially viable businesses, building strong operating structures, and ensuring each venture delivers sustainable growth and returns.
The GM will have direct oversight of ProTaxi, the Group’s e-hailing and mobility business, while also contributing to the growth and strategic direction of the Group’s real estate investment and wealth-building platforms and other innovation businesses. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy, commercial performance, operations, investments, partnerships and execution.
Key Responsibilities
Group Strategy & New Ventures
Lead the strategic development and commercial performance of the Group’s innovation and new business portfolio.
Evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, investments and expansion opportunities.
Develop business plans, operating models and go-to-market strategies for new ventures.
Identify synergies across the Group’s real estate, investment, mobility and other businesses.
Establish appropriate KPIs, budgets and performance targets for each business unit.
Present regular performance reports, insights and recommendations to the Managing Director/Owner.
Build scalable systems and processes that allow new ventures to grow sustainably.
Real Estate & Investment Businesses
Support the strategic growth and commercial performance of the Group’s real estate businesses.
Work closely with leadership on real estate investment opportunities, development projects and portfolio growth.
Contribute to the development and commercialisation of the Group’s wealth-building and real estate investment products.
Evaluate investment opportunities, business models, partnerships and potential returns.
Monitor portfolio performance, investment economics, risks and key commercial indicators.
Build relationships with investors, developers, financial institutions and other relevant ecosystem partners.
Identify opportunities to expand the Group’s investment and wealth-building offerings.
ProTaxi / Mobility & Fleet Operations
Lead the Abuja launch and oversee the overall commercial and operational performance of ProTaxi.
Own revenue, operating costs, city P&L and per-vehicle profitability.
Develop and continuously review driver earnings, repayment and incentive structures.
Own fleet utilisation and ensure vehicles achieve maximum productive utilisation.
Oversee driver acquisition, onboarding, performance and retention.
Manage the mobility operations team and key external partners.
Establish operating standards and ensure consistent customer experience.
Work closely with product engineering team on technology, product issues, operational requirements and improvements.
Build relationships with relevant government agencies, commercial partners and mobility ecosystem stakeholders.
Monitor key mobility metrics including revenue, utilisation, trip volumes, driver performance, customer retention and vehicle profitability.
Commercial & Financial Management
Own the commercial performance of assigned businesses and ensure alignment with the Group’s financial objectives.
Develop and manage annual budgets, forecasts and business performance plans.
Monitor revenue, costs, margins, cash flow and return on investment.
Assess unit economics and profitability across business lines.
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement measures to improve margins and returns.
Work with finance and other relevant teams to ensure appropriate financial controls and reporting.
Leadership & Partnerships
Lead lean, high-performing teams across the Group’s innovation businesses.
Set clear objectives, KPIs and accountability structures for business unit leaders and teams.
Build and manage relationships with strategic partners, investors, regulators, vendors and other key stakeholders.
Represent the Group in relevant commercial, investment, real estate, mobility and ecosystem engagements.
Coordinate cross-functional initiatives across the Group’s businesses.
Ideal Profile
The ideal candidate is a commercially strong operator with 8+ years of relevant experience across a combination of real estate, investments/wealth management, mobility, logistics, fleet operations, asset finance, fintech or other operations-heavy businesses.
Experience does not need to come from all these sectors, but the candidate should demonstrate the ability to understand and manage assets, investments, operations and commercial performance.
Required Experience & Capabilities
8+ years of progressive experience in general management, business operations, investments, real estate, mobility, logistics, fleet management, fintech or related fields.
Demonstrated experience leading a business, business unit, portfolio or new venture.
Strong commercial and financial management experience, including budgets, P&L, unit economics and profitability.
Practical experience in real estate, property investment or real estate-backed investment products.
Understanding of wealth-building, investment products, asset-backed businesses or portfolio management.
Experience managing physical assets, vehicle portfolios, fleets or other asset-intensive operations is highly valuable.
Experience building or scaling a new business, product or venture from an early stage.
Strong understanding of partnerships, business development and commercial negotiations.
Experience managing teams and external stakeholders.
Strong analytical and decision-making ability.
Ability to operate strategically while remaining closely involved in execution.
Strong understanding of the Nigerian business and regulatory environment.
Particularly Valuable
Experience in real estate investment, development or property finance.
Experience with wealth management, investment platforms, fintech or alternative investment products.
Experience managing fleet, logistics, transportation or mobility businesses.
Experience with asset financing, vehicle financing or driver/asset repayment models.
Experience launching businesses or products in new markets.
Existing relationships within the real estate, investment, mobility, government or financial ecosystem.
Abuja/FCT market experience.
What Success Looks Like
In this role, success will be measured by the ability to:
Build profitable and scalable businesses across the Group's portfolio.
Successfully launch and grow ProTaxi in Abuja.
Improve fleet utilisation and vehicle-level profitability.
Grow revenue while maintaining disciplined operating costs.
Strengthen the Group’s real estate and investment propositions.
Identify and execute commercially viable new ventures.
Build strong strategic partnerships and ecosystem relationships.
Establish clear operating systems, KPIs and accountability across the businesses.
Provide the owners with clear, timely and commercially useful business intelligence for decision-making.

Monitor the health status of breeder and commercial poultry flocks across assigned farms.

Membership of relevant professional associations will be an added advantage.

Proven experience in flock health management, disease diagnosis, vaccination programmes, and biosecurity implementation.

Strong knowledge of poultry diseases, pathology, and preventive medicine.
Excellent understanding of commercial poultry production systems.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Leadership and team management abilities.
High level of integrity and attention to detail.
Ability to work under pressure and respond effectively to disease outbreaks.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
Willingness to travel across farm locations as required.

The Total Rewards Officer will support the design, implementation and administration of reward programmes that attract, motivate and retain high-performing employees.

Total Rewards Strategy & Administration:
CompareBenefits Plans
Support the implementation of the Company's Total Rewards strategy in alignment with business objectives.

Review existing reward practices and recommend improvements based on business needs, employee expectations and market trends.

Coordinate long-service awards, performance recognition, spot awards and other approved recognition initiatives.
Monitor participation and effectiveness of recognition programmes.
Recommend innovative and cost-effective ways to recognise and reward employees.
Ensure recognition initiatives support the Company's culture and desired behaviours.

Develop regular Total Rewards reports and dashboards for HR and Management.
Analyse salary structures, compensation costs, benefits utilisation and reward trends.
Prepare compensation and benefits reports for Management decision-making.
Track reward-related KPIs and identify emerging trends.
Analyse employee compensation by grade, function, location and other relevant categories.
Provide data-driven insights to support workforce planning and reward decisions.
Reward Budgeting & Cost Management:
Support the preparation of annual compensation and benefits budgets.
Monitor reward expenditure against approved budgets.
Analyse the financial impact of proposed salary reviews, allowances, benefits and incentive schemes.
Identify opportunities to optimise reward costs without compromising employee value.
Support Management with cost-impact analysis for proposed reward initiatives.

Respond to employee enquiries relating to compensation, benefits and reward programmes.
Explain reward policies, salary structures and benefit provisions clearly and professionally.
Prepare employee communication materials relating to reward initiatives.
Support the development of employee total reward statements where applicable.
Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive employee compensation information.
Process Improvement:
Review Total Rewards processes and identify opportunities for greater efficiency, accuracy and employee experience.
Develop and maintain appropriate process documentation and controls.
Recommend improvements to HR systems and reward administration processes.
Support automation and digitisation of compensation and benefits processes where appropriate.
Ensure reward processes are consistently applied across the organisation.

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Relations or a related discipline.
Professional certification or membership of CIPM, SHRM, WorldatWork, ICAN, ACCA or another relevant professional body will be an advantage.
Minimum of 3–5 years' relevant experience in Total Rewards, Compensation & Benefits, HR Operations, Payroll or a related HR function.
Strong understanding of compensation structures, salary administration and employee benefits.
Good knowledge of Nigerian payroll, PAYE, pension and other relevant statutory requirements.
Demonstrable experience in salary benchmarking, job evaluation, grading and compensation analysis.
Experience supporting incentive, bonus and employee recognition programmes.
Strong numerical, analytical and data interpretation skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with HR/payroll systems.
Excellent attention to detail and strong ability to work with confidential employee data.
Strong communication and employee advisory skills.
Ability to analyse complex data and convert findings into practical recommendations.
Strong organisational skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines.

Total Rewards Management
Compensation & Benefits
Salary Benchmarking
Job Evaluation & Grading
Compensation Analytics
Reward Strategy
Benefits Administration
Incentive & Bonus Management
Employee Recognition
Payroll Controls
Reward Budgeting
HR Data Analytics
Market Intelligence
Statutory Compliance
Employee Advisory
Advanced Excel
Confidentiality & Integrity
Process Improvement

The ideal candidate will be analytical, commercially minded, numerate and highly detail-oriented, with the ability to understand both the financial and employee implications of reward decisions.
You should be comfortable working with sensitive compensation data, analysing large volumes of information and providing clear recommendations to HR and Management.
Beyond routine compensation administration, the successful candidate should have the ability to contribute to building a fair, competitive and sustainable Total Rewards framework that supports employee attraction, engagement, performance and retention.

Define project scope, objectives, timelines, resource requirements and performance indicators.
Monitor project progress against approved schedules, budgets and specifications.
Identify project risks, delays and constraints and implement appropriate corrective actions.

Ensure construction activities are executed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, drawings, BOQs and applicable standards.

Review technical submissions, method statements, shop drawings and material specifications.
Coordinate technical interfaces between different engineering disciplines.

Monitor daily construction activities and ensure work is progressing according to approved programmes.

Ensure non-conformities are documented, investigated and closed out.
Maintain appropriate project quality records.

Job Description:
We are looking for an experienced Inventory Manager to lead inventory operations at our fulfillment center, ensuring stock is accurate, available and cost-efficient.
You will lead a team of inventory associates, strengthen inventory controls, and work with cross-functional teams and suppliers to keep customer orders moving on time.
What you will be doing
Oversee and manage all aspects of inventory management within the fulfillment center, including receiving, storing, counting, and tracking inventory levels to ensure accuracy and availability of stock.
Develop and implement inventory control procedures, policies, and best practices to optimize inventory accuracy, minimize shrinkage, and reduce carrying costs while meeting customer service requirements.
Monitor and maintain inventory levels to support operational needs and fulfill customer orders in a timely manner, collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Purchasing, Sales, and Operations, to optimize inventory levels and stock replenishment strategies.
Conduct regular cycle counts, physical inventories, and reconciliations to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and implement corrective actions to resolve inventory discrepancies and improve accuracy.
Utilize inventory management systems (IMS) and technology tools to track inventory movements, monitor stock levels, and generate reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) for management review.
Coordinate with external vendors and suppliers to manage inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and ensure timely and accurate receipt of goods and materials.
Lead and develop a team of inventory associates, providing guidance, support, and training to ensure compliance with inventory management policies, procedures, and safety guidelines.
Develop and implement strategies to optimize warehouse layout, storage configurations, and picking processes to maximize space utilization, improve efficiency, and minimize handling costs.
Analyze inventory data and trends to identify opportunities for process improvement, cost reduction, and inventory optimization, and implement initiatives to enhance inventory management practices.
Prepare and present regular reports and updates on inventory performance, including inventory levels, turnover rates, and accuracy metrics, to senior management.
What we are looking for
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field; Master's degree or certification in inventory management is a plus.
5+ years of experience in inventory management, warehouse operations, or supply chain management, with demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills.
Strong knowledge of inventory management principles, practices, and systems, with experience in implementing inventory control procedures and best practices in a fast-paced distribution or fulfillment center environment.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data sets, identify trends, and develop insights and recommendations to optimize inventory performance.
Proficiency in using inventory management systems (IMS), warehouse management systems (WMS), and other technology tools for inventory tracking, reporting, and analysis.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with team members, management, and stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Results-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering tangible business outcomes and driving continuous improvement in inventory management practices.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and as part of a team.
Flexibility to work variable shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed to support operational needs.
We Offer
A unique experience in an entrepreneurial, yet structured environment
A unique opportunity of having strong impact in building the African e-commerce sector
The opportunity to become part of a highly professional and dynamic team
An unparalleled personal and professional growth as our longer-term objective is to train the next generation of leaders.

We are looking for an experienced
Sales Manager – Public Sector
to lead and grow our government and public institution business. You will own the full sales cycle, from spotting opportunities early and building relationships with key decision-makers to leading business opportunities or tender responses and closing multi-year contracts. You will need a strong grasp of public procurement processes and a proven record of selling complex IT services and solutions into the public sector.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales Strategy
Develop and execute a public sector sales strategy aligned with company growth targets and government technology priorities.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new opportunities across national, regional, and local government entities as well as other public institutions.
Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline, with accurate forecasting and regular reporting to leadership.
Meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue, bookings, and margin targets.
Tenders & Procurement
Monitor procurement portals, tender notices, and framework agreements to catch opportunities early.
Lead bid/no-bid decisions and coordinate responses to RFIs, RFPs, EOIs, and tenders.
Work with technical, delivery, legal, and finance teams to prepare compliant, competitive, high-quality proposals.
Ensure full compliance with public procurement laws, regulations, and ethical standards.
Stakeholder & Account Management
Build trusted relationships with senior government officials, CIOs, ICT directors, procurement officers, and other key stakeholders.
Manage and expand existing public sector accounts, finding upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Understand clients' policy goals, budget cycles, and digital agendas, and position solutions to support them.
Represent the company at government forums, industry events, conferences, and trade associations.
Partnerships & Collaboration
Develop strategic partnerships with technology vendors (e.g., Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, SAP, Cisco), system integrators, and local partners to strengthen bids.
Work closely with solution architects and pre-sales consultants to shape solutions that meet client requirements.
Share market intelligence and client feedback with marketing and service delivery teams.
Contract Negotiation & Closing
Lead commercial negotiations, pricing strategy, and contract finalization within approved guidelines.
Ensure smooth handover to delivery teams and stay involved to keep clients satisfied and win repeat business.
Qualifications & Experience
Required
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field.
7+ years of B2B sales experience in IT services, consulting, or technology solutions, with at least 4 years selling to the public sector.
Proven track record of winning and closing large, complex public sector contracts.
Solid knowledge of public procurement laws, tendering processes, and government budgeting cycles.
An established network of relationships within government ministries, agencies, or public institutions.
Good understanding of IT solutions such as cloud, cybersecurity, ERP, digital government platforms, data analytics, and managed services.
Excellent proposal writing, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Preferred
MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.
Professional certifications in sales, procurement, or project management (e.g., CIPS, PMP, PRINCE2).
Experience with donor-funded or development partner projects (e.g., World Bank, AfDB, USAID, EU).
Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Experience with public-private partnership (PPP) models.
Key Competencies
Strategic thinking with a results-driven mindset
Strong relationship-building and influencing skills at senior levels
High integrity and commitment to ethical business practices
Ability to handle long, complex sales cycles with patience and persistence
Excellent written and verbal communication
Team player who works well across departments
Key Performance Indicators
Revenue and bookings against target
Pipeline value and conversion rate
Tender win rate
New accounts acquired and growth in existing accounts
Client satisfaction and retention

The objective of the Waiter/Waitress is to ensure that every guest receives timely, accurate, courteous and professional service while supporting efficient restaurant operations, maintaining service standards and contributing positively to customer satisfaction, repeat patronage and revenue.
Job Summary
We are seeking courteous, well-groomed, attentive and service-oriented Waiters and Waitresses to provide excellent dining and guest service within a hospitality and entertainment environment.
The successful candidate will be responsible for welcoming guests, taking and serving food and beverage orders, maintaining service standards, supporting restaurant operations and ensuring every guest receives a professional, friendly and memorable experience.
This is a highly customer-facing role that requires strong communication, good personal presentation, attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome and attend to guests professionally and courteously.
Present menus and provide clear information about available food and beverage options.
Take accurate food and drink orders.
Enter orders correctly into the approved POS or restaurant management system.
Communicate guest orders promptly and accurately to the kitchen and bar teams.
Serve food and beverages according to established service standards.
Confirm that guests receive the correct orders.
Check on guests during service without being intrusive.
Respond professionally to guest requests, concerns or complaints.
Escalate unresolved guest issues to the Supervisor or Restaurant Manager.
Prepare tables before service and reset tables promptly after guests leave.
Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of tables, chairs and surrounding service areas.
Ensure cutlery, glassware, napkins and other service materials are properly arranged.
Assist with restaurant opening and closing procedures.
Maintain knowledge of menu items, prices, promotions and unavailable items.
Recommend suitable meals, drinks or add-ons when appropriate.
Support upselling and cross-selling initiatives without pressuring guests.
Handle bills and payments according to approved procedures.
Ensure cash, POS and payment transactions are properly processed.
Issue receipts to customers when required.
Immediately report payment discrepancies or system issues.
Support event, banquet, restaurant and special-function service when assigned.
Work closely with kitchen, bar, cashier, restaurant supervisor and other service staff.
Follow all food-safety, hygiene and operational procedures.
Report damaged equipment, shortages, spills or safety hazards immediately.
Protect the company's property, equipment and service materials.
Guest Service Standards:
The Waiter/Waitress is expected to:
Greet guests warmly and respectfully.
Maintain a friendly and professional attitude throughout service.
Listen carefully to guests and communicate clearly.
Avoid unnecessary arguments or confrontation with customers.
Maintain appropriate eye contact and positive body language.
Never ignore a guest requiring assistance.
Maintain confidentiality and respect guest privacy.
Treat all customers fairly and professionally.
Demonstrate patience when dealing with difficult or demanding guests.
Maintain composure during busy service periods.
Personal Presentation and Grooming Standards:
Because this is a front-of-house hospitality role, the successful candidate must:
Maintain excellent personal hygiene.
Be consistently neat and professionally groomed.
Wear the approved uniform correctly and keep it clean.
Maintain clean footwear, hair, hands and fingernails.
Avoid excessive jewellery, fragrances or accessories while on duty.
Maintain a professional and welcoming appearance.
Be confident interacting directly with guests.
Maintain good posture and professional body language.
Be physically capable of standing and moving for extended periods during service.
Maintain an energetic and positive appearance during working hours.
Key Performance Indicators
Performance will be assessed using indicators such as:
Guest satisfaction.
Accuracy of orders.
Speed of service.
Customer complaints attributable to service.
Table turnaround time.
Upselling performance.
Attendance and punctuality.
Adherence to grooming standards.
Cleanliness of assigned service areas.
Compliance with POS and payment procedures.
Teamwork and cooperation.
Knowledge of menu items.
Compliance with operational and hygiene procedures.
Preferred Qualifications
Minimum of secondary-school education or equivalent.
Hospitality, catering or customer-service training is an advantage.
Previous experience in a restaurant, hotel, lounge, café, bar or similar hospitality environment is preferred.
Prior experience using a restaurant POS system is an advantage.
Candidates without extensive experience may be considered where they demonstrate strong attitude, communication and willingness to learn.
Required Skills and Competencies:
Strong customer-service skills.
Good verbal communication skills.
Ability to listen and follow instructions.
Basic numeracy skills.
Ability to use a POS or restaurant management system.
Good attention to detail.
Ability to remember menu items and customer requests.
Ability to multitask during busy periods.
Strong teamwork skills.
Ability to remain calm under pressure.
Good personal organization.
Ability to work quickly without sacrificing service quality.
Basic understanding of food hygiene and restaurant service procedures.
Personal Attributes:
The ideal candidate should be:
Courteous and respectful.
Well-groomed and presentable.
Friendly and approachable.
Honest and trustworthy.
Energetic and hardworking.
Patient with customers.
Observant and attentive.
Punctual and dependable.
Disciplined.
Able to follow instructions.
Comfortable working as part of a team.
Willing to learn and improve.
Conduct and Ethics
The Waiter/Waitress must:
Never request tips from guests.
Never alter customer bills or transactions.
Never consume customer food or beverages.
Never remove company property without authorization.
Never disclose guest information.
Never engage in inappropriate conversations with guests.
Never report to work under the influence of alcohol or prohibited substances.
Avoid the use of personal mobile phones during active service except when authorized for work purposes.
Immediately report suspected fraud, theft or misconduct.
Follow all company policies, SOPs and instructions from authorized supervisors.
Working Conditions
The role may require:
Shift work.
Weekend and public-holiday duties.
Evening or night shifts.
Standing for extended periods.
Moving between restaurant, bar, event and guest-service areas.
Supporting high-volume service during events and peak periods.

Job Description:
Industry: Fashion / Apparel Production
Work Arrangement: On-site – Live-in Role
Remuneration: ₦200,000 – ₦300,000 Net Monthly, based on experience and competence
Accommodation: Provided as part of the live-in arrangement
About the Role
Tabs Atelier is seeking an experienced, highly organised and hands-on Production Manager to oversee the day-to-day management of its fashion production operations.
The Production Manager will be responsible for ensuring that garments move efficiently from design and production planning through cutting, sewing, fitting, finishing and final quality control, while meeting the brand's required standards for quality, fit, finishing and delivery timelines.
This is a key operational role requiring someone who understands fashion production practically and can effectively coordinate tailors, cutters, finishers and other production personnel.
The successful candidate must be able to take ownership of the production floor, anticipate potential delays, resolve production challenges quickly and ensure that customer orders and collections are delivered to the required standard and within agreed timelines.
This is a live-in position, and suitable accommodation will be provided by the company.
Key Responsibilities
Production Planning & Coordination
Plan and coordinate daily, weekly and monthly production activities.
Translate confirmed orders and approved designs into clear production schedules.
Allocate production assignments to tailors, cutters, finishers and other production personnel based on competence, capacity and deadlines.
Establish realistic production timelines for individual garments, customer orders and collections.
Monitor every stage of production to ensure work progresses according to schedule.
Prioritise urgent orders without unnecessarily disrupting existing production commitments.
Maintain an up-to-date production schedule showing jobs in progress, completed jobs and pending orders.
Identify potential production delays early and take corrective action.
Ensure production capacity is properly utilised and minimise avoidable downtime.
Production Floor Management
Take responsibility for the effective day-to-day running of the production floor.
Coordinate and supervise all production personnel.
Ensure production staff understand assigned tasks, specifications and deadlines.
Monitor attendance, punctuality, productivity and general work discipline within the production team.
Ensure appropriate workflow between cutting, sewing, fitting, alterations, finishing and quality control.
Identify production bottlenecks and resolve them promptly.
Ensure the production environment remains organised and conducive to efficient work.
Escalate significant production or staffing issues to Management when necessary.
Garment Construction & Technical Supervision
Review designs and production requirements before commencement of work.
Ensure garments are constructed according to approved designs, measurements and specifications.
Provide practical guidance to production personnel where technical clarification is required.
Identify construction issues that may affect fit, finishing or production feasibility.
Ensure measurements are accurately interpreted and followed.
Monitor alterations and corrections to ensure identified issues are properly resolved.
Work closely with relevant design and client-facing personnel where clarification is required before or during production.
Quality Control & Assurance
The Production Manager will have primary responsibility for maintaining Tabs Atelier's production quality standards.
Responsibilities include:
Conduct quality checks at critical stages of production rather than waiting until garments are completed.
Inspect completed garments before they are approved for customer delivery.
Ensure garments meet approved standards for measurement, fit, stitching, finishing and overall appearance.
Check seams, hems, zips, buttons, embellishments, lining and other finishing details.
Identify defects and ensure corrections are completed promptly.
Prevent defective or unfinished garments from being released to customers.
Investigate recurring quality issues and implement corrective measures.
Reduce customer complaints arising from preventable production errors.
Promote a strong culture of quality and attention to detail across the production team.
Order & Delivery Management
Track customer orders from production commencement through completion.
Ensure agreed production and delivery dates are clearly communicated internally.
Monitor upcoming deadlines and prioritise production accordingly.
Coordinate fittings, alterations and final corrections where applicable.
Ensure completed garments are ready ahead of agreed collection or delivery dates wherever possible.
Immediately flag any risk to an agreed delivery date.
Maintain accurate records of completed, outstanding and delayed orders.
Work closely with Client Service and relevant team members to ensure accurate production updates are available.
Fabric, Materials & Inventory Control
Ensure required fabrics, trims and production materials are available before work begins.
Verify materials issued for individual jobs.
Monitor the utilisation of fabrics and production materials.
Minimise avoidable fabric wastage, damage and misuse.
Maintain appropriate records of materials issued to production.
Identify low-stock production materials and communicate replenishment requirements promptly.
Ensure unused fabrics, offcuts and materials are appropriately accounted for and stored.
Support periodic inventory counts relating to production materials.
Cost & Waste Management
Monitor production processes with attention to cost efficiency.
Reduce avoidable rework, fabric wastage and production errors.
Identify practices that unnecessarily increase production costs.
Ensure production resources are used responsibly.
Monitor the causes of rejected or repeated work and recommend corrective action.
Support Management with information required to understand the cost and efficiency of production.
Production Team Management
Supervise tailors, cutters, finishers and other production personnel.
Set clear daily and weekly expectations for the production team.
Monitor individual productivity and quality of work.
Provide appropriate feedback, guidance and correction.
Identify performance or skill gaps within the production team.
Recommend training or development where necessary.
Support the onboarding and practical assessment of new production personnel.
Promote teamwork, accountability, professionalism and respect within the production environment.
Escalate disciplinary or persistent performance issues appropriately.
Equipment & Workplace Management
Ensure production machines, equipment and tools are properly handled.
Maintain appropriate records of equipment faults and maintenance requirements.
Ensure faults are reported promptly to minimise production downtime.
Encourage preventive care and responsible use of production equipment.
Ensure production areas are properly organised at the end of each work cycle.
Support adherence to reasonable workplace health and safety standards.
10. Production Reporting
The Production Manager will provide Management with clear and accurate information on production performance.
Reports should cover:
Orders received for production;
Orders currently in production;
Orders completed;
Orders delivered;
Outstanding orders;
Delayed orders and reasons for delay;
Alterations/rework;
Production capacity;
Material shortages;
Quality-control issues;
Staff productivity;
Equipment issues; and
Other matters requiring Management attention.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be assessed against measurable indicators including:
Production Delivery
Percentage of orders completed within agreed production timelines.
Number of overdue production orders.
Average production turnaround time.
Ability to manage urgent and priority orders effectively.
Quality
Percentage of garments passing final quality inspection.
Number of garments requiring avoidable rework.
Number of production-related customer complaints.
Accuracy of garment measurements and finishing.
Productivity
Production output against planned capacity.
Productivity of production personnel.
Effective allocation and utilisation of production resources.
Reduction in unnecessary production downtime.
Cost & Waste Control
Fabric and material wastage.
Frequency of avoidable production errors.
Level of rework resulting from production mistakes.
Responsible utilisation of production resources.
Team Management
Attendance and punctuality of production staff.
Adherence to production schedules.
Production-floor discipline and organisation.
Effective resolution and escalation of production issues.
Reporting & Accountability
Accuracy of production records.
Timeliness of production reports.
Early identification and escalation of potential delays.
Accuracy of order-status information.
Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate should possess:
HND/B.Sc. or relevant professional/technical qualification in Fashion Design, Garment Production, Clothing Technology, Production Management or a related discipline. Strong practical experience may be considered in place of a specific academic qualification.
Minimum of 3–5 years' relevant experience in fashion production, garment manufacturing, tailoring operations or a similar production environment.
Previous experience supervising tailors, cutters, finishers or fashion-production personnel.
Strong practical understanding of garment construction and production processes.
Demonstrable experience managing multiple orders and production deadlines.
Experience in quality control within a fashion or garment-production environment.
Good understanding of fabrics, measurements, finishing and garment-production requirements.
Experience within a structured fashion brand will be a strong advantage.
Required Skills & Competencies
The successful candidate must demonstrate:
Strong production planning and coordination skills.
Practical knowledge of garment construction.
Excellent attention to detail.
Strong quality-control orientation.
Leadership and people-management ability.
Ability to coordinate artisans and production personnel effectively.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively under pressure.
Good time and deadline management.
Strong organisational ability.
Inventory and material-management awareness.
Cost and waste consciousness.
Clear communication and reporting skills.
Ability to hold team members accountable while maintaining professionalism.
Integrity and reliability.
Strong sense of ownership and responsibility.
The Ideal Candidate
Tabs Atelier is looking for someone who does not merely monitor production, but takes ownership of it.
The ideal candidate should be able to walk onto the production floor and quickly determine:
What needs to be produced;
Who is responsible for each job;
What stage every order has reached;
Whether materials are available;
Whether production is on schedule;
Which orders are at risk of delay;
Whether completed garments meet the required standard; and
What action is required to keep production moving.
The successful candidate should be comfortable working closely with artisans while maintaining appropriate standards of discipline, accountability, quality and productivity.
Work Arrangement – Live-In
This is a full-time, on-site live-in position.
The successful candidate will be required to reside in the accommodation provided by Tabs Atelier as part of the employment arrangement.
The live-in arrangement is intended to support the operational requirements of the role and effective oversight of production activities.
Specific working hours, rest periods, days off and other conditions of employment will be clearly defined in the employment agreement.
The live-in arrangement should not be interpreted as requiring unrestricted or continuous availability outside agreed working hours.
Remuneration
₦200,000 – ₦300,000 Net Monthly
Final remuneration will be determined based on the successful candidate's:
Relevant production-management experience;
Technical knowledge of garment construction;
Previous leadership responsibility;
Quality-control competence;
Ability to manage production teams;
Demonstrated ability to meet production deadlines; and
Overall suitability for the role.
Accommodation will be provided in accordance with the company's live-in arrangement.
What Tabs Atelier Offers
Competitive net monthly remuneration within the stated range.
Company-provided accommodation under the live-in arrangement.
Opportunity to take ownership of a key operational function within a growing Nigerian fashion brand.
Direct involvement in improving production quality, efficiency and capacity.
Opportunity to lead and develop a fashion-production team.
Clearly defined responsibilities and performance expectations.
Opportunity for professional growth as the business expands.

Job Description:
Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) Ltd/Gte is currently recruiting a
WASH Engineer
based in Maiduguri and Katsina. The responsibilities include overseeing technical interventions aimed at improving access to safe water, sanitation facilities, and hygiene practices, while supporting the rehabilitation of community infrastructure and strengthening the resilience of vulnerable populations in Borno and Katsina States. The hired candidate will also provide technical guidance to project teams, coordinate with relevant stakeholders, and contribute to sustainable solutions that address the needs of affected communities.
Position Details
Reporting to: Programme Manager
Proposed start date: October 2026
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Mission 1: Overall supervision of water and sanitation construction activities including preparing technical designs and bills of quantities
Support the governance and sustainable access to safe water by working with RUWASA, LGAs, and other stakeholders to implement WASH governance recommendations.
Together with partner, conduct technical assessments, prepare designs, and develop Bills of Quantities (BoQs) for water and sanitation facilities rehabilitation, upgrade and new construction. To visit sites and ensure quality assurance of construction being delivered and adherence to design specifications
To make sure that the technical activities are up to the ACF standards (WASH package)
Facilitate the selection, design and construction of sanitation and water systems. In water using ground water or surface water, including abstraction, storage, treatment and distribution for new systems or rehabilitation of existing systems.
In collaboration of partner, assess sanitation needs, and design and implement the most appropriate form of sanitation system, in consultation with male and female beneficiaries, which includes excreta disposal, refuse disposal, vector control and drainage that can contribute to sanitation ladder using available resources at affordable price that meet at least minimum standard.
Consider different maintenance mechanisms, ensuring that they are appropriate to the local context and cultural norms and that facilities are sustainable
Regularly conduct water quality test/analysis from and inform result to WASH technical team for decision.
Coordinate the data collection in targeted aquifers and monitor water levels, temperature, and conductivity in collaboration with NIHSA.
Mission 2: Build the capacity of staff and partners including community engagement.
Prepare training tools on relevant technical topics and conduct trainings for both internal staff and external stakeholders
Development of technical guidelines and tools related to quality WASH intervention.
Assess areas for improvement and recording lessons learnt for future activities
Support the formation gender-sensitive WASH Committees (WASHCOMs) and artisan in target communities, ensuring female representation.
Building the capacity of consortium partners on water, sanitation and hygiene.
Train and build the capacity of WASHCOMs (WASH Committees), local artisans, Government stakeholders and partners on the construction and maintenance of WASH facilities.
Engage with communities to ensure their active participation in the planning, implementation, and monitoring of WASH activities.
Mission 3: Coordinate with internal staff and local stakeholders to ensure smooth project implementation
Liaise closely with the Hygiene promotion officer throughout the planning, design and implementation stages of the WASH technical activities.
Together with san mark officer and logistic, support the identification and selection of TBOs using the SOPs and ACF guidelines.
Collaborate closely with the sanitation-marketing officer to integrate sustainable sanitation and hygiene practices into community and institutional settings, including the promotion of latrine construction, hygiene awareness campaigns, and waste management initiatives.
Ensure that effective communication and networking is developed and maintained through partnership and collaboration
Team with local Government and sectoral stakeholders/counterparts to exchange information on WASH technical implementation status
Build a data base of technical support projects and share with relevant stakeholders
In collaboration with relevant stakeholders, ensure each activity a sustainability plan is consider at the design stage and put to action.
Mission 4: Coordination and Reporting WASH activities
Maintain effective communication with partners, local government and sectoral stakeholders, exchanging information on the status of WASH technical activities.
Prepare and submit regular technical reports, including progress updates, data/facility mapping, and quality assessments, using tools like MWater
Liaise with other team members to develop trainings , Monitoring and Evaluation reports
Prepare and share WASH section weekly, monthly and quarterly/annual progress reports to program manager.
Assist in development of weekly, biweekly and monthly activity report as directed by WASH program manager
Coordinate with logistics, HR, and finance teams regularly to ensure alignment with project goals and resource allocation.
Liaise with on-site construction supervision personnel on technical matters and provide technical reports to the Programme Manager as needed.
Mission 5: Quality Assurance and Sectoral Engagement
Regularly engage with implementing partners to gather insights, provide technical feedback, and address challenges in WASH implementation.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of WASH practices by documenting lessons learned, sharing best practices, and participating in sectoral coordination meetings and workshops.
Ensure that all WASH activities comply with SPHERE minimum standards and other relevant guidelines, maintaining a strong focus on quality, safety, and sustainability.
Advocate for the integration of WASH services with other sectoral interventions, including health, education, and livelihoods, to maximize the impact and sustainability of the project.
Additional Responsibilities
This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will also perform other related tasks as required and responsible for reporting and communication of progress and achievement of the specific assigned task
Maintenance of high technical standards
Conduct all duties in a professional manner following ACF Nigeria mission staff regulations, ACF mandate and charter including promotion of gender equality
Position Requirements:
Minimum of Bachelor’s degree/HND in Civil Engineering, Water engineering, Geology, Building and other related fields
At least 3 years of progressive experience in supervising WASH-related construction activities, including the design and implementation of water and sanitation infrastructure.
Previous experience in supervising water and sanitation construction and rehabilitation activities
Experience working in the humanitarian sector, preferably with ACF
Strong communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with communities and government stakeholders.
Ability to adapt and be flexible in changing environments.
Fluent in Hausa and English, with excellent report-writing and technical presentation skills. Kanuri language ability is an advantage.

:
